rule: No menu price is set until the dish has a real food cost and a measured labor time
why: A price chosen before cost is a guess presented as a decision
evidence_needed_before_a_price_exists: Session receipts and yields; timed prep and service
test: food_costing.py economics shows food cost and direct variable cost computable

rule: Prices are tested as a range with real guests, not announced
why: Stated willingness to pay is intent, not behavior
evidence_needed_before_a_price_exists: A lawful paid test (gate BG-2) or, before that, stated-price questions kept separate and labelled INTENT
test: Compare stated price with what people actually buy at a pop-up or residency

rule: Shareable dishes are priced as shared plates, tacos and quesadillas as singles
why: The product is designed to be shared; pricing should not fight the format
test: Order mix and check per guest from real sales

rule: One drink pairing offer, zero-proof priced on the same logic as beer
why: Equal standing is part of the concept; a lower-priced or afterthought NA offer would contradict it
evidence_needed_before_a_price_exists: NA cost and prep time from trials; beer cost from a brewer
test: Attach rates for beer and zero-proof pairings from real sales

rule: A flight or pairing offer is judged by whether guests understand it in about a minute, not by margin first
why: Pairing clarity is the differentiator; a confusing offer loses it
test: Observation: do guests order a pairing unprompted

rule: No price signals value the brewery before beer exists
why: House beer is untested; implying a premium for it would be unsupported
test: Draft velocity and repeat for the pilot beer
